source.section: PDF p.44-45 Form 39R instructions Line 7; PDF p.33 Form 39R Part B line 7; PDF p.10 Line 12a; PDF p.11 worksheet line 5 ('born before January 2, 1961'); Form 40 lines 7-11, 12a, 15-20, 26 (PDF p.29-30); instructions PDF p.10-11 Standard Deduction Worksheet lines 1-6 and Line 20 worksheet lines 1-5; PDF p.13-14 Line 43 and Food Tax Credit Worksheet; PDF p.12 Line 31; record brackets and base.deductions cites

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = IRA distribution (person 0) 40,000.00 + railroad retirement annuity (person 0) 22,000.00 = 62,000.00. Federal taxable income = 62,000.00 - 15,750.00 federal standard deduction - 1 x 2,000.00 age 65 additional = 44,250.00 (the federal senior deduction is ignored). Form 40 (filing status single): line 7 federal AGI 62,000.00. Line 8 additions 0.00; line 9 = 62,000.00 + 0.00 = 62,000.00. Form 39R Part B line 7 Social Security and railroad benefits included in federal income = 0.00 + 22,000.00 = 22,000.00. Line 8: no qualifying retirement benefits, line 8f 0.00. Line 18 health insurance premiums: none in the inputs, 0.00. Line 24 total subtractions = 22,000.00 + 0.00 = 22,000.00. Form 40 line 10 22,000.00; line 11 total adjusted income = 62,000.00 - 22,000.00 = 40,000.00. Line 12a boxes checked 1. Standard Deduction Worksheet: line 1 15,750.00; line 4 15,750.00; line 5 1 x 2,000.00 = 2,000.00; line 6 17,750.00. Line 15 0.00 (no Schedule A); line 16 17,750.00. Line 17 = 40,000.00 - 17,750.00 = 22,250.00. Line 18 federal Form 1040 lines 13a and 13b taken as 0.00; line 19 Idaho taxable income 22,250.00. Line 20 worksheet: line 1 22,250.00; line 2 4,811.00; line 3 = 17,439.00; line 4 at 5.3%; line 5 tax = 17,439.00 x 5.3% = 924.267, to the cent 924.27 (the return rounds to whole dollars, PDF p.8, and shows 924; expected keeps the formula). Lines 21-24 credits 0.00; line 25 0.00; line 26 924.27. Food Tax Credit Worksheet (Form 40 line 43): 1 x 155.00 = 155.00. State income tax = 924.27 - 155.00 = 769.27. Line 31 Permanent Building Fund tax 10.00 is on the return but the projection does not charge it (approximations). Line 18 would take any federal Schedule 1-A amount, the senior deduction included; it is ignored here and the projection does not subtract it (approximations).
accepted_approximations: The Permanent Building Fund tax of 10 a return (Form 40 line 31) is not charged.
The federal Schedule 1-A and qualified business income deductions are not subtracted (Form 40 line 18).
